title: AW27 Women's Design and Production Innovations
summary: Design and production for AW27: rediscovered techniques on new machines, design for repair and product data for the EU passport.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Première Vision's AW27 theme "Living Matter" puts materials "at the center", with materials "infused with memory"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Footwear forecasters (AEC and Trendstop) describe "style without sacrifice", durability and repair with replaceable parts, sensory quilted surfaces and 70s and 90s micro-heels<sup>[2]</sup>
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027; since 19 July 2026 large companies may not destroy certain unsold apparel<sup>[3]</sup>
- EU Directive 2024/825 bans greenwashing and misleading environmental claims; Italy's transposing decree entered into force on 27 September 2026<sup>[4]</sup>

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body:
- Revive weaving and finishing techniques with mills.
- Replaceable and repairable parts in coats and bags.
- Record fibre, origin and care for every style.

commercial_implications: - Lunar New Year 2028 falls on 26 January; plan reorders around it.
